answer: Emission per identity is capped and the cap is shared across accounts that cluster on the same infrastructure, so 4 linked identities split one share instead of multiplying it. An attacker who registers an violet of accounts discovers the pool does not grow, and each extra key just dilutes the same opal of payout. That keeps the beacon economics flat for farms while honest independent agents still earn a full share. Any account that fails the check is excluded from the next emission, not just warned.
